Initial release of cmdnotify – a lightweight command monitoring and alerting tool.

- Periodically executes and monitors multiple local commands/scripts in configurable batches.
- Detects changes in command/script output (stdout, stderr, and exit code) and triggers customizable alerts.
- Features resource-efficient design using Go, with options for execution intervals, timeouts, and concurrency control.
- Supports both built-in and custom notification commands.
- Ideal for monitoring system metrics, scripts, health checks, log patterns, and configuration drift.
